commit.message:
Add ATTRIBUTE_PRINTF and regression test

Fix -Wformat-nonliteral warning on macOS/clang by annotating
trace_compiler_thread_added() with ATTRIBUTE_PRINTF(2, 3).

Add regression test that runs with -XX:+StressBailout and
-XX:+TraceCompilerThreads to verify no crash when a compiler
thread exits before it can be tracked.
